purpose: Protocol assessment only; no normalization fitting, parameters or corrected arrays
boundaryRationale: One native SCL20m cell width measured against native class-support geometry; reduces boundary mixture without guaranteeing purity or choosing a width by radiometry. Do not erode the artificial core boundary.

candidates.rule: Original finite positive RGB, SCL4, mu>=0.3, complete1km native terrain ray, no model blocker, and distance>=20m from native non-SCL4 support
candidates.meaning: Broad dated processor vegetation only; diagnostic comparator

candidates.rule: P1 AND native WorldCover2021 code30 grassland support with distance>=20m from non-code30 support
candidates.meaning: Dated SCL vegetation plus older annual herbaceous-cover context; not current grass/material truth

candidates.rule: P2 AND historical NRW Phase1 D.1.1 dry acid heath support, distance>=20m inside union of native non-mosaic D.1.1 polygons
candidates.meaning: Historically habitat-stratified comparator; does not assert contemporary dry acid heath

candidateChoice: Compare semantic specificity first, not count/correlation optimization. No other mask, class or guard search. NRW D.1.1 chosen from the pre-existing documented summit heath case before new statistics.

spatialDesign.dependenceStatistic: Descriptive eligible endpoint Pearson at E/N offsets; no exact effective sample size or independence claim

gateRationale: Design safeguards for two fitted coefficients per band and four spatial holdouts, not universal power thresholds or effective sample sizes. 20 is an occupied-block support guard, not a substitute for four dispersed heldout blocks. Failure of any gate stops a proposed experiment.
reusedGeometry: Only read-only load/sun/rays from tryfan-illumination-normalization/experiment.py; no baseline/run writes
allowedDiagnostics: Masks, counts, distributions, descriptive Pearson, texture, spectral ratios, connected components, spatial blocking and endpoint dependence; no regression coefficients or correction model fit
choiceAfterAssessment: Can select a semantically justified candidate passing all predeclared gates; no new masks or softened gates after results. If none passes, record no-go.
